# Abstraction behavioral fixtures

`structured-evidence.json` retains the bounded authored package from a synthetic local
CSV trial on October 23, 2026. It contains no protected original CSV content.
`recorded-provider-outputs.json` preserves the reported local and hosted raw-output
exhibits and hashes of their source artifacts. The hosted source was a different
synthetic fixture, so these historic observations are not a matched comparison.

The evaluator supplies exactly the same retained package and reconstructed small
controls to each provider. Its bare-acronym case is reconstructed; the exact recent
user-reported acronym exhibit has not been recovered. Its `gloss_repaired` output
applies only the existing acronym collapse, not the complete ingestion pipeline.
Numeric, identifier, scope and instruction compliance need per-case adjudication.

Three calls per case are repeated observations rather than a guarantee or a retry
remedy. Raw, repaired and stored/served outcomes are different evidence classes.
